title: The Office: That's What She Said
description: Workplace absurdity in a Pennsylvania paper company—five sitcom depths.

questions.question: Michael Scott's "World's Best Boss" mug sits in his office at the Scranton branch of what paper company?
questions.explanation: In the pilot, Michael admits he bought the mug himself at Spencer Gifts. In 2011 the fake company started selling real paper through Staples' Quill.com.

questions.question: At Dunder Mifflin, what comeback does Michael fire off whenever someone says something accidentally suggestive?
choices: Well, well, well, how the turntables
questions.explanation: He fires it off for years, right up to the finale ("Michael, I can't believe you came"). So it means something when he swallows one mid-word.

questions.question: In "Goodbye, Toby," Michael stops himself mid-"That's what she said" because he's smitten with which new HR rep?
questions.explanation: Amy Ryan's Holly arrives as Toby's replacement, swapping Michael's nemesis for his soulmate. They bond the way only they could: doing Yoda voices.

questions.question: In "Garage Sale," Michael walks Holly past the office's romantic landmarks, then proposes at her desk surrounded by what?
questions.explanation: Coworkers holding candles each "propose" first. Then the candles trip the fire sprinklers mid-speech, and a soaked Holly still says yes.

questions.question: Right after his candles-and-sprinklers proposal, Michael stuns everyone: he and Holly are moving to what state?
questions.explanation: In "Goodbye, Michael" he slips out early and, at the airport, hands back his mic. His last, unheard words to the crew: "That's what she said."
